sloka: ततः त्वाम् निहतम् दृष्ट्वा वायुः गन्ध वहः स्वयम् ।त्रैलोक्यम् भृश संक्रुद्धो न ववौ वै प्रभंजनः ॥४-६६-२५॥
transliteration: tataḥ tvām nihatam dṛṣṭvā vāyuḥ gandha vahaḥ svayam ।trailokyam bhṛśa saṁkruddho na vavau vai prabhaṁjanaḥ ॥4-66-25॥

translations.english: The Windgod who is a carrier of fragrance and breaker of trees became very angry on seeing (the injury on) you and stopped blowing in the three worlds.
